passages.text: In the fourth year of King Darius, the word of the LORD came to Zechariah on the fourth day of the ninth month, the month of Chislev.
passages.sermon:
King Darius ruled as king.
This was the fourth year of his reign.
The LORD spoke to Zechariah.
This happened on the fourth day of the ninth month.
The ninth month is called Chislev.
passages.original: וַֽיְהִי֙ בִּשְׁנַ֣ת אַרְבַּ֔ע לְדָרְיָ֖וֶשׁ הַמֶּ֑לֶךְ הָיָ֨ה דְבַר־ יְהוָ֜ה אֶל־ זְכַרְיָ֗ה בְּאַרְבָּעָ֛ה לַחֹ֥דֶשׁ הַתְּשִׁעִ֖י בְּכִסְלֵֽו׃

passages.text: Now the people of Bethel had sent Sharezer and Regem-melech, along with their men, to plead before the LORD by asking the priests of the house of the LORD of Hosts, as well as the prophets, “Should I weep and fast in the fifth month, as I have done these many years?”
passages.sermon:
The people of Bethel sent Sharezer and Regem-melech.
They sent these men with their companions.
They wanted to seek the favor of the LORD.
They went to the priests who served at the house of the LORD of Hosts.
They also went to the prophets.
They asked a question.
They said, “Should I weep in the fifth month?
Should I fast as I have done for many years?”
passages.original: וַיִּשְׁלַח֙ בֵּֽית־ אֵ֔ל שַׂר־ אֶ֕צֶר וְרֶ֥גֶם מֶ֖לֶךְ וַֽאֲנָשָׁ֑יו לְחַלּ֖וֹת אֶת־ פְּנֵ֥י יְהוָֽה׃ לֵאמֹ֗ר אֶל־ הַכֹּֽהֲנִים֙ אֲשֶׁר֙ לְבֵית־ יְהוָ֣ה צְבָא֔וֹת וְאֶל־ הַנְּבִיאִ֖ים לֵאמֹ֑ר הַֽאֶבְכֶּה֙ בַּחֹ֣דֶשׁ הַחֲמִשִׁ֔י הִנָּזֵ֕ר כַּאֲשֶׁ֣ר עָשִׂ֔יתִי זֶ֖ה כַּמֶּ֥ה שָׁנִֽים׃פ

passages.text: Then the word of the LORD of Hosts came to me, saying, “Ask all the people of the land and the priests, ‘When you fasted and mourned in the fifth and seventh months for these seventy years, was it really for Me that you fasted?
passages.sermon:
The LORD of Hosts spoke to me.
He gave me a message.
He told me to speak to all the people of the land.
He told me to speak to the priests.
He said, “You fasted and mourned in the fifth month and in the seventh month.
You did this for seventy years.
Did you really fast for Me?
Was it truly for Me that you fasted?”
passages.original: וַיְהִ֛י דְּבַר־ יְהוָ֥ה צְבָא֖וֹת אֵלַ֥י לֵאמֹֽר׃ אֱמֹר֙ אֶל־ כָּל־ עַ֣ם הָאָ֔רֶץ וְאֶל־ הַכֹּהֲנִ֖ים לֵאמֹ֑ר כִּֽי־ צַמְתֶּ֨ם וְסָפ֜וֹד בַּחֲמִישִׁ֣י וּבַשְּׁבִיעִ֗י וְזֶה֙ שִׁבְעִ֣ים שָׁנָ֔ה הֲצ֥וֹם צַמְתֻּ֖נִי אָֽנִי׃

passages.text: And when you were eating and drinking, were you not doing so simply for yourselves?
passages.sermon:
The LORD of Hosts spoke to the people through Zechariah.
He asked about their actions.
He said, “When you eat, you eat for yourselves.
When you drink, you drink for yourselves.
You do not eat and drink for Me.
You do these things to satisfy yourselves.”
passages.original: וְכִ֥י תֹאכְל֖וּ וְכִ֣י תִשְׁתּ֑וּ הֲל֤וֹא אַתֶּם֙ הָאֹ֣כְלִ֔ים וְאַתֶּ֖ם הַשֹּׁתִֽים׃

passages.text: Are these not the words that the LORD proclaimed through the earlier prophets, when Jerusalem and its surrounding towns were populous and prosperous, and the Negev and the foothills were inhabited?’ ”
passages.sermon:
The LORD spoke through the earlier prophets.
He gave His words to the people.
At that time, Jerusalem was full of people.
Jerusalem was at peace.
The towns around Jerusalem were also full of people.
The Negev region had people living in it.
The foothills were also inhabited.
These are the same words the LORD proclaimed then.
passages.original: הֲל֣וֹא אֶת־ הַדְּבָרִ֗ים אֲשֶׁ֨ר קָרָ֤א יְהוָה֙ בְּיַד֙ הַנְּבִיאִ֣ים הָרִֽאשֹׁנִ֔ים בִּהְי֤וֹת יְרוּשָׁלִַ֙ם֙ יֹשֶׁ֣בֶת וּשְׁלֵוָ֔ה וְעָרֶ֖יהָ סְבִיבֹתֶ֑יהָ וְהַנֶּ֥גֶב וְהַשְּׁפֵלָ֖ה יֹשֵֽׁב׃פ

passages.text: Then the word of the LORD came to Zechariah, saying, “This is what the LORD of Hosts says: ‘Administer true justice. Show loving devotion and compassion to one another.
passages.sermon:
The LORD of Hosts spoke to Zechariah.
The LORD gave Zechariah a message.
The LORD of Hosts said these words.
Judge with true justice.
Show loving devotion to each other.
Show compassion to one another.
passages.original: וַֽיְהִי֙ דְּבַר־ יְהוָ֔ה אֶל־ זְכַרְיָ֖ה לֵאמֹֽר׃ כֹּ֥ה אָמַ֛ר יְהוָ֥ה צְבָא֖וֹת לֵאמֹ֑ר מִשְׁפַּ֤ט אֱמֶת֙ שְׁפֹ֔טוּ וְחֶ֣סֶד וְרַֽחֲמִ֔ים עֲשׂ֖וּ אִ֥ישׁ אֶת־ אָחִֽיו׃

passages.text: Do not oppress the widow or the fatherless, the foreigner or the poor. And do not plot evil in your hearts against one another.’
passages.sermon:
The LORD of Hosts speaks.
He gives a command.
Do not oppress the widow.
Do not oppress the fatherless.
Do not oppress the foreigner.
Do not oppress the poor.
Do not plan evil in your heart against your brother.
passages.original: וְאַלְמָנָ֧ה וְיָת֛וֹם גֵּ֥ר וְעָנִ֖י אַֽל־ תַּעֲשֹׁ֑קוּ וְרָעַת֙ אִ֣ישׁ אָחִ֔יו אַֽל־ תַּחְשְׁב֖וּ בִּלְבַבְכֶֽם׃

passages.text: But they refused to pay attention and turned a stubborn shoulder; they stopped up their ears from hearing.
passages.sermon:
The people refused to listen.
They did not pay attention.
They turned away with stubbornness.
They made their shoulders hard and unyielding.
They stopped up their ears.
They would not hear.
passages.original: וַיְמָאֲנ֣וּ לְהַקְשִׁ֔יב וַיִּתְּנ֥וּ כָתֵ֖ף סֹרָ֑רֶת וְאָזְנֵיהֶ֖ם הִכְבִּ֥ידוּ מִשְּׁמֽוֹעַ׃

passages.text: They made their hearts like flint and would not listen to the law or to the words that the LORD of Hosts had sent by His Spirit through the earlier prophets. Therefore great anger came from the LORD of Hosts.
passages.sermon:
The people made their hearts hard like flint.
They refused to listen to the law.
They refused to listen to the words from the LORD of Hosts.
The LORD of Hosts had sent these words by His Spirit.
He sent them through the earlier prophets.
Because of this, great anger came from the LORD of Hosts.
passages.original: וְלִבָּ֞ם שָׂ֣מוּ שָׁמִ֗יר מִ֠שְּׁמוֹעַ אֶת־ הַתּוֹרָ֤ה וְאֶת־ הַדְּבָרִים֙ אֲשֶׁ֨ר שָׁלַ֜ח יְהוָ֤ה צְבָאוֹת֙ בְּרוּח֔וֹ בְּיַ֖ד הַנְּבִיאִ֣ים הָרִֽאשֹׁנִ֑ים וַֽיְהִי֙ קֶ֣צֶף גָּד֔וֹל מֵאֵ֖ת יְהוָ֥ה צְבָאֽוֹת׃

passages.text: And just as I had called and they would not listen, so when they called I would not listen, says the LORD of Hosts.
passages.sermon:
The LORD of Hosts spoke to the people of Israel.
He called to them.
They did not listen to Him.
The LORD of Hosts said, “When they call to Me, I will not listen to them.”
passages.original: וַיְהִ֥י כַאֲשֶׁר־ קָרָ֖א וְלֹ֣א שָׁמֵ֑עוּ כֵּ֤ן יִקְרְאוּ֙ וְלֹ֣א אֶשְׁמָ֔ע אָמַ֖ר יְהוָ֥ה צְבָאֽוֹת׃

passages.text: But I scattered them with a whirlwind among all the nations that they had not known, and the land was left desolate behind them so that no one could come or go. Thus they turned the pleasant land into a desolation.”
passages.sermon:
The LORD of Hosts acted with power.
He scattered the people with a whirlwind.
He sent them among all the nations.
These nations were unknown to them.
After they left, the land became empty.
No one could pass through the land.
No one could return to the land.
They made the pleasant land a wasteland.
They turned the good land into a desolation.
passages.original: וְאֵ֣סָעֲרֵ֗ם עַ֤ל כָּל־ הַגּוֹיִם֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר לֹֽא־ יְדָע֔וּם וְהָאָ֙רֶץ֙ נָשַׁ֣מָּה אַֽחֲרֵיהֶ֔ם מֵֽעֹבֵ֖ר וּמִשָּׁ֑ב וַיָּשִׂ֥ימוּ אֶֽרֶץ־ חֶמְדָּ֖ה לְשַׁמָּֽה׃פ
